Scope: hits `skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md` + `.changeset/30275-plugin-dev-feature-flags-bullet.md`; cited on `origin/main`: `packages/services/service-settings/src/index.ts`, `src/settings-service.ts`, `src/settings-service-plugin.ts`, `src/settings-service.types.ts`, `src/settings-service.test.ts`, `src/manifests/index.ts`, `README.md`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`, `docs/adr/0007-settings-manifest-and-kv-store.md`, `packages/skills/package.json`, `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`, `AGENTS.md`

### ① Derived judgments

- Net diff against current main (`git diff origin/main...997decb3`): exactly two files, `+12/-3`; `git log origin/main..997decb3` is the one docs commit `677b6cb2` plus the merge `997decb3`, and the merge carries nothing of its own (the three-dot diff is identical to the PR file list). Correct.
- Removed claim: the `feature_flags` manifest / `ai_enabled` / `beta_*` / `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` bullet (old L354-356). On main that namespace is gone: `manifests/index.ts:4-16,29` lists no feature-flags manifest and no `featureFlagsSettingsManifest` export; `settings-service.test.ts:44-60` pins `getManifest('feature_flags')` to `{ code: 'SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE' }` with `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED: 'true'` in env and `svc.get('feature_flags','ai_enabled')` rejecting (env var inert). PR #30272 (merged 2026-11-05T05:47Z) removed `src/manifests/feature-flags.manifest.ts` and the `index.ts` export. Removal is correct.
- New claim "no shared flags namespace exists": true on main (`manifests/index.ts:29` aggregate; `settings-service.test.ts:51` asserts `builtinSettingsManifests` does not contain `feature_flags`).
- New claim "declares its own `SettingsManifest`": `SettingsManifest` is a type re-export from `@objectstack/service-settings` "so plugin authors only need one import" (`src/index.ts:179-182`), source `@objectstack/spec/system`. Correct name.
- New claim "registers it on the `settings` service": `SettingsServicePlugin` declares `providesServices = ['settings']` (`settings-service-plugin.ts:180`) and calls `ctx.registerService('settings', this.service)` (`:264`); `SettingsService.registerManifest(manifest: SettingsManifest): void` is a public class method (`settings-service.ts:1246`) and is the documented plugin API (`README.md:12,18`: `kernel.getService('settings')` → `registerManifest(manifest)`). The reference page already teaches `ctx.getService(...)` (head L103, L240, L268), so the sentence is coherent with the page. Correct.
- "(ADR-0007 cascade)": `docs/adr/0007-settings-manifest-and-kv-store.md:77,98` documents the one-resolver env > tenant > user layering with env highest; the word "cascade" is the old bullet's wording kept, a fair paraphrase. Env override for a plugin's own manifest is generic: `envKeyOf(namespace,key)` → `OS_${NAMESPACE}_${KEY}` (`settings-service.types.ts:643-646`), used at `settings-service.ts:1393`, so the implied cascade holds for any registered namespace. The new text makes no `OS_*` claim of its own. Correct.
- Neighbouring bullet (`PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES`, head L356-358) is byte-unchanged and still true: `export const PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` at `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts:95`, `requiresFeature` lowering documented at `:30,304`. The bullet's `kernel/public-auth-features.ts` path is a pre-existing short form of `packages/spec/src/kernel/…`, not touched by this PR.
- Acceptance 1 met (bullet replaced with the live answer, deployment capability left to the next bullet). Acceptance 2: `git grep -i 'feature_flags|OS_FEATURE_FLAGS|ai_enabled'` over `skills/` at head returns nothing (exit 1); the package's only eval `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` does not mention them, and no eval in any package prompts for feature flags (grep `flag|toggle` over `skills/*/evals/**` hits only unrelated automation/UI evals). Acceptance 3: #30272 is merged and head's text differs from main only by this hunk. Dev's "skills/** grep hits only that bullet" claim verified (on main: `plugin-development.md:354,356` only).
- Stale `feature_flags` mentions remain on main outside `skills/**` (`docs/adr/0007…:230,334`, `docs/adr/0028…:227`, `docs/adr/0128…:55`, `content/docs/releases/v9.mdx:93`) — outside this card's file surface (dispatch: `skills/**` only, ⛔ `packages/**`), ADRs are historical records; not a finding against this PR.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` (`.changeset/30275-plugin-dev-feature-flags-bullet.md:2`), package exists at `packages/skills/package.json`. Docs-only edit to a shipped skills reference: patch is the correct level per `AGENTS.md:1019-1020` (published package → patch, never `skip-changeset`). Changeset body carries line-initial `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` (lines 7-8, verified with `cat -A`), consistent with the PR body (`Fixes #30275` / `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`, lines 3-5). `Metadata-protocol: none` re-derives correctly: nothing under `packages/spec/**` or any metadata-author-facing key changes. "Check Changeset" check-run: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation (relay `pr_create` HTTP 500 ×3 on `677b6cb2`, then merged `origin/main` and retried → PR #30726 on `997decb3`): answered — the merge commit adds no content of its own (①, first bullet); judged on the net diff only.
- Dev `open_questions`: none. NOT MEASURED `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` / `check:lean-entry-closure` (need built dist): acceptable narrowing for a Markdown + changeset diff; CI covers them.
- File-surface pins respected: no `SKILL.md`, no `packages/**`, no `evals/config-plugins-ops.json` touched (PR file list: 2 files).
- Token ratchet: dev reports 3137→3125 (ceiling 3137 unchanged), not re-run here (read-only); the diff is net −1 line / shorter text, so the ratchet cannot have moved up; `Lint · docs & code guards` will confirm.
- PR author `user.login` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]`: no external author to name. PR is draft; `skills/**` is Tier H (`AGENTS.md:271-275`): landing waits on the maintainer.
- Head check-runs at 2026-11-05T23:41Z: 0 failed; 9 still `in_progress` (Test Core 1/8 & 2/8, Lint ×3, Type Check ×4); all completed runs success or skipped. Clause ② of the landing gate ("all green") is not yet satisfiable — record stands, the landing seat must re-read check-runs before enqueue.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md` (hunk L354-355): the replacement teaches exactly what a customer agent must do — declare a `SettingsManifest`, register it on the `settings` service — using names that resolve on main (①), without inventing an `OS_*` promise, and leaves the deployment-capability case to the unchanged `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` bullet, matching card acceptance 1. The section header's framing ("live toggle surfaces are runtime configuration") still holds for both bullets. Token-negative. No must-fix.

`.changeset/30275-plugin-dev-feature-flags-bullet.md`: level, declarations and summary correct (②). No must-fix.

should-fix 1 (optional, not blocking): the bullet could name the entry point in one phrase (`ctx.getService('settings').registerManifest(...)`) so a reader need not infer the method from the service name; `README.md:18` is the source. Headroom is 12 tokens, so only if it fits the ratchet.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-platform` 插件开发参考页删掉已不存在的 `feature_flags` 设置清单(`ai_enabled` / `beta_*` / `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*`),改成现行做法:插件需要组织级开关时,自己声明 `SettingsManifest` 并注册到 `settings` 服务。
- 为什么改:PR #30272 已删除该命名空间,`getManifest('feature_flags')` 现在会被拒;旧文本会让 AI 写出针对不存在命名空间的检查,或让管理员设一个无效的环境变量。
- 风险与回滚:一处技能文档 + changeset,不动代码;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-platform/references/plugin-development.md` 第 354–355 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -i feature_flags -- skills/` 应为空。
- 需要你做的:批准并合并(`skills/**` 为 Tier H)。契约复核 PASS 评论 6672499661,Head-sha `997decb3e4e1abd6f71533f246585e3497e2c31b`。
- 席位意见:可合。复核的可选建议(点名 `registerManifest(...)` 入口)没有做,不值得为它再推一次。
